summary: Rain's coverage looks clearly ahead on paper — Sinistcha and Incineroar both take double damage from multiple Rain attacks — but Trick Room's entire premise is moving first regardless of raw power, so a well-timed Matcha Gotcha can undo that math before it matters.
keyFactors: Pelipper's Hurricane and Swampert's Ice Punch are both super effective against Sinistcha — Rain has two independent ways to threaten Trick Room's setter.
Swampert's Wave Crash and Earthquake are both super effective against Incineroar too, giving Rain broad coverage across two of the three Trick Room pieces.
Sinistcha's Matcha Gotcha is a 4x hit on Swampert (Water/Ground both weak to Grass) — if Trick Room is already up when it fires, this alone can flip the exchange.
Farigiraf takes nothing worse than neutral damage from any of Rain's common moves, making it the safer Trick Room piece to lead with into this matchup.
